info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Compliance Reporting API
info.description: The Compliance Reporting API facilitates the retrieval of compliance reports related to banking activities. It enables financial institutions to access comprehensive reports that outline adherence to regulatory requirements and standards. Typical consumers include compliance officers and auditors who need timely access to compliance data for review and analysis. This API streamlines the process of obtaining critical information to ensure transparency and regulatory compliance.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of compliance reporting, providing insights into various compliance metrics and statuses. Use this to monitor compliance adherence and performance over relevant reporting periods.
